newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria to call grain import tender for 300,000 t.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria to call grain import tender for 300,000 t.

text.p: Bulgaria is expected to call a grain import tender for 300,000 tonnes of wheat among seven leading international grain trading companies, trade minister Atanas Paparisov said on Thursday.
"We expect to chose an importer within a week so that the first delivery of wheat will come by the beginning of January," Paparisov said. He did not elaborate.
The first wheat delivery of around 60,000 tonnes of wheat are expected to be covered by a $12 million state guarantee.
The State Fund of Reconstruction and Development (SFRD) will provide $10 million and the remaining two million dollars by Bulgaria's state-owned Bulbank. -- Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-84561
